notes.title: Worldview introduction
notes.notes:
1. Outline of the world situation (background)
We call the single individuals of this world the same civilization as human beings "humans."

"This world has never passed through people from the future, so time machines do not exist." This seemingly rigorous reasoning is not as convincing as most mathematical inferences.

"What if they (time travelers) have never been observed? Assuming that their quantum mechanics is very mature, they can become quantum-like in some way, requiring specific observations to exist. Or maybe There are many parallel universes, but our parallel universe is not favored by them? Assuming they exist, it must be "them". It is an organization. What if such an organization has regulations that strictly prohibit destroying the order of time and space?"

"With such regulations, there must be people who enforce them, and there must be people who maintain the rules."

"Such people and organizations have become a truth: time machines cannot be invented and observed by anyone in any form in the long history of normal civilization."

They always jokingly call themselves ‘people living in three points and five dimensions’, yes, they really exist in every world.

At the beginning, it is impossible to talk to them about leaders, organizational systems, and other things that an organization should have. Some of them have forgotten these things in the tributaries of a long time, and some people have never cared about them since the beginning. No matter who they are, no matter what they have gone through, it is unintentional inspiration, the crystallization of ideals, the regret of regret, the pain of parting that urges them to search for the truth in the world... No matter what these are, most of them have experienced the fear of being dominated by time-even if there are countless times of power from scratch, it only brings them numbness and giving up. Even if they can move freely in the direction of time, they grow in three-dimensional space, as if living in that gap. Three-dimensional becomes so narrow for them, just like two-dimensional versus three-dimensional.

They can't understand four dimensions after all.

Therefore, in countless tributaries of time, either obtained a body of longevity, or ended one's time in a certain corner.

The remaining people, those whose bodies are still alive, have such a high wall that they cannot pass:
It is strictly forbidden to disrupt the time order.

As a result, they struggled to find the meaning of life again-to defend that truth:
The time machine cannot be invented and observed by anyone in any form in the long history of normal civilization.

They tell each other, yes, they are not alone. These people-the inventors of the time machine, are representatives of scientific rationality. They insist on not resisting that rule, even if there are countless parallel universes in theory. They will wander endlessly on the "three-point five-dimensional universe" that they do not want to leave, and they still choose to maintain that truth.

On the way to tell each other, they broke out a war-known in history as the "first time war."
The cause of the war has nothing to do with race or belief, but with themselves. Some people couldn't stand their selves in other parallel universes and provoked a war.
Unreasonable death at the beginning of a war is common, and the person in the conversation disappears. People who provoke a war generally choose extremely high technology from various eras and various parallel universes (because of the existence of rules and the complexity of time travel) The degree and the huge cost, as well as the existence of the grandfather’s paradox, generally no one chooses to go back to the past and kill the other party), which makes this war different from a normal civilized war. It is too quiet.

When the war reached its climax, the reasons for the beginning were different. All the "three-point and five-dimensional people" were living in fear of whether they would survive the next moment, and everyone was forced to participate in the war.

Until someone touched the iron law.

The war began to stop-to be precise, the war never started.


Those who started the war at the beginning won the victory. They gathered together to greatly reduce the cost of time travel. The grandfather's paradox was correctly eliminated: the antimatter injected with the same energy as the time machine stopped the division of the universe and made the time machine invalid. (The essence of the time machine is to use huge energy to split the universe). The time machine is invented by the other party and passed through to stop it, making the time machine inoperable or overloading and exploding, preventing the other party from trying to travel through time for the first time. The machine is called: "Antimatter Stop the wormhole". Nowadays, they have destroyed all the visible selves in the parallel universe-it is not necessary for them to do it themselves. Artificial intelligence has been extremely mature in their era, and some people have even escaped the destruction of civilization caused by artificial intelligence through the time machine, but Some people like to do it themselves. They are tired of waiting in time travel. For them, a second is extremely long.

After the war ended, let’s just say that after they eliminated most of the people who opposed them, most of the few people left began to reflect. The result of some people’s reflection was: obliterate all observable inventors who will invent the time machine. This is a more direct way to avoid the recurrence of wars than to stop the division of the universe. This has a disagreement with another group of people. Their idea is only to destroy the same self and have nothing to do with others. Now that the war is over, those people should be given the right to choose.

The "First Time War" produced several high-profile leaders, among them the main scientists who broke the grandfather’s paradox were among them. In these leaders’ efforts to fight against the Second War and at the same time ban "anti-matter" Curb the use of wormholes. The remaining people gradually divided into two factions: the choice faction and the obliteration faction. At the same time, they call people who have not yet invented time machines (referring to inventors and their individuals in other parallel universes) as "new people."

The obliteration faction is very decisive, and most of the work is done by artificial intelligence instead.
There are serious internal divisions among the selectionists. The selection moderates believe that they should intervene in the life of the new generations, and moderately prevent them from inventing the time machine. The disadvantage of this is that the butterfly effect is huge and the future is uncontrollable. Even artificial intelligence. It is impossible to match those people one by one (most of the artificial intelligence people are designed for war, and there are few artificial intelligence that simulates human emotions). The radicals believe that they should be put together before they invented the time machine, and they should be psychologically evaluated. If the result is biased towards killing each other, then let them kill each other until the result is separated. This method has an impact on psychological activities. Very fast or high EQ and IQ races are invalid, and their mental state cannot be measured. Therefore, some radicals even think that it is enough to let them kill each other with only one representative.

The two major factions are implementing their own plans in different parallel universes. They are like the gods of the new-born school, and they are the destiny makers of the new-born school.
All stories will begin here.

ii. When the antimatter memory monitors the observable parallel universe state, The universe that is about to split and its parallel universes [Parallel universe: A universe with a single civilization similarity greater than 79% is called a parallel universe. ] After marking the anti-quantum entanglement (in case the sub-universe of the universe cannot be found after the exponential explosion caused by the splitting too fast), scan the black hole with the Schwarzschild radius and the wormhole with a radius of more than one light-year in the universe for information injection In this way, the position of the new faction is reversed, and the executor will evaluate the intervention plan and carry out an obliteration plan.

ii. Means of intervention:
a) Guiding options: When designing Yuanzi [defective] artificial intelligence people intervene in the life of the new generation, guiding them to fail to invent a time machine.
b) Situational psychological evaluation plan: Convene the new students to use mind-inducing technology to place the inventor in a virtual world behind the scene of simulating the invention of a time machine, perform evolutionary calculations and evaluate the risk factor to decide whether to obliterate the crowd.
c) Compulsory destruction plan: After the psychological assessment of the situation, representative individuals are left behind to obliterate other new students. ,
